+#!/usr/bin/python
+# Copyright: Ansible Project
+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+ANSIBLE_METADATA = {'metadata_version': '1.1', 'status': ['preview'], 'supported_by': 'community'}
+
+DOCUMENTATION = '''
+---
+module: icx_logging
+version_added: '2.9'
+short_description: Manage logging on Ruckus ICX switches
+author: Ansible Project
+description:
+  - Configure logging destinations and facilities on Ruckus ICX 7000 switches.
+options:
+  dest:
+    description: Logging destination.
+    choices: [on, host, console, buffered, persistence, rfc5424]
+    type: str
+  name:
+    description: Hostname or IP address of a syslog server.
+    type: str
+  udp_port:
+    description: UDP port of a syslog server.
+    type: str
+  facility:
+    description: Syslog facility to set or clear.
+    type: str
+  level:
+    description: Buffered logging level or list of levels.
+    type: str
+    choices: [alerts, critical, debugging, emergencies, errors, informational, notifications, warnings]
+  aggregate:
+    description: List of logging settings to manage together.
+    type: list
+    elements: dict
+  state:
+    description: Whether the setting should be present or absent.
+    type: str
+    choices: [present, absent]
+    default: present
+  check_running_config:
+    description: Compare desired settings to the running configuration.
+    type: bool
+    default: true
+'''
+
+EXAMPLES = '''
+- name: Configure IPv6 syslog and a facility
+  icx_logging:
+    aggregate:
+      - {dest: host, name: '2001:db8::1', udp_port: '514'}
+      - {facility: local7}
+- name: Disable console logging
+  icx_logging:
+    dest: console
+    state: absent
+'''
+
+RETURN = '''
+commands:
+  description: Configuration commands sent to the device.
+  returned: always
+  type: list
+'''
+
+import re
+from copy import deepcopy
+from ansible.module_utils.basic import AnsibleModule, env_fallback
+from ansible.module_utils.network.icx.icx import get_config, load_config
+from ansible.module_utils.network.common.utils import validate_ip_v6_address
+
+LEVELS = ('emergencies', 'alerts', 'critical', 'errors', 'warnings',
+          'notifications', 'informational', 'debugging')
+DESTINATIONS = ('on', 'host', 'console', 'buffered', 'persistence', 'rfc5424')
+
+
+def count_terms(check, param=None):
+    keys = param if param is not None else check
+    if isinstance(keys, str):
+        keys = [keys]
+    return sum(check.get(key) is not None for key in keys)
+
+
+def check_required_if(module, spec, param):
+    for key, value, required in spec or []:
+        if param.get(key) == value:
+            missing = [item for item in required if param.get(item) is None]
+            if missing:
+                module.fail_json(msg='%s is required when %s is %s' % (', '.join(missing), key, value))
+
+
+def search_obj_in_list(name, lst):
+    for item in lst:
+        if item.get('name') == name:
+            return item
+    return None
+
+
+def diff_in_list(want, have):
+    return set(want) - set(have), set(have) - set(want)
+
+
+def parse_port(line, dest):
+    if dest == 'host':
+        match = re.search(r'\budp-port\s+(\d+)\b', line)
+        if match:
+            return match.group(1)
+    return None
+
+
+def parse_name(line, dest):
+    if dest == 'host':
+        match = re.match(r'^logging host (?:ipv6 )?(\S+)', line.strip())
+        if match:
+            return match.group(1)
+    return None
+
+
+def parse_address(line, dest):
+    return dest == 'host' and bool(re.match(r'^logging host ipv6\s+\S+', line.strip()))
+
+
+def _object(dest=None, name=None, udp_port=None, facility=None, level=None,
+            state='present', addr6=False):
+    return dict(dest=dest, name=name, udp_port=udp_port, facility=facility,
+                level=level, state=state, addr6=addr6)
+
+
+def map_params_to_obj(module, required_if=None):
+    params = module.params
+    entries = params.get('aggregate') or [params]
+    result = []
+    rules = required_if or [('dest', 'host', ['name']), ('dest', 'buffered', ['level'])]
+    for entry in entries:
+        item = dict((key, entry.get(key) if entry.get(key) is not None else params.get(key))
+                    for key in ('dest', 'name', 'udp_port', 'facility', 'level', 'state'))
+        check_required_if(module, rules, item)
+        dest = item['dest']
+        if dest not in DESTINATIONS and dest is not None:
+            module.fail_json(msg='unsupported logging destination: %s' % dest)
+        if not dest and item['facility'] is None:
+            module.fail_json(msg='dest or facility is required')
+        if dest != 'host':
+            item['name'] = item['udp_port'] = None
+        else:
+            item['addr6'] = bool(validate_ip_v6_address(item['name']))
+            if item['udp_port'] is not None:
+                item['udp_port'] = str(item['udp_port'])
+        if dest == 'buffered':
+            levels = item['level'] if isinstance(item['level'], (list, tuple, set)) else [item['level']]
+            if any(level not in LEVELS for level in levels):
+                module.fail_json(msg='invalid buffered logging level')
+            item['level'] = set(levels)
+        else:
+            item['level'] = None
+        if dest != 'host':
+            item['addr6'] = False
+        item['state'] = item['state'] or 'present'
+        result.append(item)
+    return result
+
+
+def map_config_to_obj(module):
+    config = get_config(module, None, compare=module.params['check_running_config'])
+    lines = [line.strip() for line in config.splitlines()]
+    result = []
+    facility = 'user'
+    buffered = False
+    buffered_levels = set()
+    all_buffered = False
+    excluded = set()
+    for line in lines:
+        if line.startswith('logging host '):
+            result.append(_object('host', parse_name(line, 'host'),
+                                  parse_port(line, 'host'), addr6=parse_address(line, 'host')))
+        elif line.startswith('logging facility '):
+            facility = line.split()[2]
+        elif line == 'logging buffered':
+            buffered = True
+            all_buffered = True
+        elif line.startswith('logging buffered '):
+            buffered = True
+            level = line.split()[2]
+            if level in LEVELS:
+                buffered_levels.add(level)
+                excluded.discard(level)
+        elif line.startswith('no logging buffered '):
+            level = line.split()[3]
+            if level in LEVELS:
+                excluded.add(level)
+        elif line == 'logging console':
+            result.append(_object('console'))
+        elif line == 'logging persistence':
+            result.append(_object('persistence'))
+        elif line == 'logging enable rfc5424':
+            result.append(_object('rfc5424'))
+    if buffered:
+        result.append(_object('buffered', level=(set(LEVELS) if all_buffered else buffered_levels) - excluded))
+    result.append(_object('facility', facility=facility))
+    if 'no logging on' not in lines:
+        result.append(_object('on'))
+    return result
+
+
+def _host_command(item, port=None):
+    command = 'logging host ' + ('ipv6 ' if item.get('addr6') else '') + item['name']
+    if port is not None:
+        command += ' udp-port ' + str(port)
+    return command
+
+
+def map_obj_to_commands(updates):
+    want, have = updates
+    commands = []
+    for item in want:
+        dest, state = item.get('dest'), item.get('state', 'present')
+        if item.get('facility') is not None:
+            current = next((entry.get('facility') for entry in have
+                            if entry['dest'] == 'facility'), 'user')
+            if state == 'present' and current != item['facility']:
+                commands.append('logging facility ' + item['facility'])
+            elif state == 'absent' and current == item['facility'] and current != 'user':
+                commands.append('no logging facility')
+        if dest is None or dest == 'facility':
+            continue
+        matches = [entry for entry in have if entry['dest'] == dest]
+        if dest == 'host':
+            matches = [entry for entry in matches if entry['name'] == item['name']
+                       and entry.get('addr6') == item.get('addr6')]
+            port = item.get('udp_port')
+            exact = [entry for entry in matches if entry.get('udp_port') == port]
+            removals = matches if port is None else exact
+            if state == 'absent':
+                for entry in removals:
+                    commands.append('no ' + _host_command(entry, entry.get('udp_port')))
+            elif not exact:
+                for entry in matches:
+                    commands.append('no ' + _host_command(entry, entry.get('udp_port')))
+                commands.append(_host_command(item, port))
+        elif dest == 'buffered':
+            current = matches[0]['level'] if matches else set()
+            levels = item['level'] or set()
+            if state == 'present':
+                adds, _ = diff_in_list(levels, current)
+                for level in LEVELS:
+                    if level in adds:
+                        commands.append('logging buffered ' + level)
+            else:
+                for level in LEVELS:
+                    if level in levels & current:
+                        commands.append('no logging buffered ' + level)
+        else:
+            command = 'logging enable rfc5424' if dest == 'rfc5424' else 'logging ' + dest
+            if state == 'present' and not matches:
+                commands.append(command)
+            elif state == 'absent' and matches:
+                commands.append('no ' + command)
+    return commands
+
+
+def main():
+    element_spec = dict(dest=dict(type='str', choices=list(DESTINATIONS)),
+                        name=dict(type='str'), udp_port=dict(type='str'),
+                        facility=dict(type='str'), level=dict(type='str'),
+                        state=dict(type='str', choices=['present', 'absent']))
+    aggregate_spec = deepcopy(element_spec)
+    argument_spec = dict(element_spec)
+    argument_spec['state']['default'] = 'present'
+    argument_spec.update(aggregate=dict(type='list', elements='dict', options=aggregate_spec),
+                         check_running_config=dict(type='bool', default=True,
+                                                   fallback=(env_fallback, ['ANSIBLE_CHECK_ICX_RUNNING_CONFIG'])))
+    module = AnsibleModule(argument_spec=argument_spec, supports_check_mode=True)
+    want = map_params_to_obj(module)
+    have = map_config_to_obj(module)
+    commands = map_obj_to_commands((want, have))
+    if commands and not module.check_mode:
+        load_config(module, commands)
+    module.exit_json(changed=bool(commands), commands=commands)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+
+from ansible.modules.network.icx import icx_logging as logging
+
+
+class Module(object):
+    def __init__(self, params):
+        self.params = params
+
+    def fail_json(self, **kwargs):
+        raise ValueError(kwargs['msg'])
+
+
+def test_aggregate_and_ipv6(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(logging, 'get_config', lambda *args, **kwargs: '''logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 514
+logging facility local7
+logging buffered
+no logging buffered debugging
+logging console
+''')
+    module = Module(dict(aggregate=[{'dest': 'host', 'name': '2001:db8::1', 'udp_port': '514'},
+                                    {'dest': 'host', 'name': '192.0.2.1', 'udp_port': '5514'},
+                                    {'facility': 'local7'},
+                                    {'dest': 'buffered', 'level': 'debugging'},
+                                    {'dest': 'console', 'state': 'absent'},
+                                    {'dest': 'on', 'state': 'absent'}],
+                         dest=None, name=None, udp_port=None, facility=None, level=None,
+                         state='present', check_running_config=True))
+    want = logging.map_params_to_obj(module)
+    have = logging.map_config_to_obj(module)
+    assert logging.map_obj_to_commands((want, have)) == [
+        'logging host 192.0.2.1 udp-port 5514',
+        'logging buffered debugging', 'no logging console', 'no logging on']
+
+
+def test_removals(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(logging, 'get_config', lambda *args, **kwargs: '''logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 514
+logging facility local7
+logging buffered
+no logging buffered errors
+''')
+    module = Module(dict(check_running_config=True))
+    have = logging.map_config_to_obj(module)
+    want = [logging._object('host', '2001:db8::1', state='absent', addr6=True),
+            logging._object(facility='local7', state='absent'),
+            logging._object('buffered', level={'warnings', 'errors'}, state='absent')]
+    assert logging.map_obj_to_commands((want, have)) == [
+        'no logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 514',
+        'no logging facility', 'no logging buffered warnings']
